answer: Each challenge binds its nonce and task parameters to a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse; domain-separated derivation makes the prompt unpredictable until that pulse is finalized, so an onyx, falcon, or plume swarm cannot precompute valid answers or farm them offline.
